title: Graph tab: deterministic SVG over catalogue and mapped-object lines
summary: Open Database Lab, choose a database and select the Graph tab. OodDatabaseLab~graphLines(extraLines) emits LF-separated, tab-delimited TABLE table rowCount; COLUMN table column type nullable(0/1) primary(0/1) unique(0/1); FK childTable childColumn parentTable parentColumn onDelete; it appends OBJECT/PART lines supplied in extraLines. The browser consumes these lines, never SQL or ::ANNOTATE. It draws a deterministic SVG with each table and typed columns, PK/UNIQUE marks, ON DELETE-labelled foreign-key arrows, and small junctions for pure two-parent link tables. Selecting a table by click or keyboard loads it in the schema editor. The optional textarea id is dbObjectLines, refresh button id dbGraphRefresh, and output container id dbGraph. For an object-bound Designer form, load the class and part targets into ObjectStore, call store~graphLines and put the returned lines in dbObjectLines, then refresh. OBJECT class primaryTable and PART class attribute|'-' EXT|ONE|MANY|LINK targetTable linkTable|'-' OWNED|SHARED come directly from ObjectStore~graphLines, as specified by mapped-objects.graph-lines; graphLines(extraLines) passes them through. Matching schema-qualified names uses the unqualified table name case-insensitively. Unknown future record kinds are ignored. The renderer outlines mapped objects and draws typed part edges; labels come from OodUi English/German db.* resources. Source: animatedads/oorexx branch feature/oodialog-database-graph-v3-20261115, commit a001470dfcabe82859cb84732e5cc406ed6615c7; DOM test database_lab_dom.cjs 24/24 PASS on Designer v0.11.
invariants: No SQL-text parsing or annotation parsing in the browser: catalogue and ObjectStore graphLines are the two authorities.
Input is tab-separated lines joined by LF, never JSON or a browser reconstruction of the object map.
Map each class of interest in ObjectStore before asking for graphLines: only mapped classes are listed.
Maintain stable ids dbObjectLines, dbGraphRefresh and dbGraph for Designer integration.
The same lines produce the same SVG layout; table choice invokes the existing schema loader.

provenance.claim: Model graphLines record contract and graph description.
